instanceMethods.name: Perform
instanceMethods.signature: (Curve: Adaptor3d_Curve, Polygon: IntCurveSurface_ThePolygonOfHInter, Surface: Adaptor3d_Surface): void
instanceMethods.comment: Compute the Intersection between the curve and the surface. The Curve is already sampled and its polygon : <Polygon> is given.

instanceMethods.name: NbPoints
instanceMethods.comment: returns the number of IntersectionPoint if IsDone returns True. else NotDone is raised.

instanceMethods.name: NbSegments
instanceMethods.comment: returns the number of IntersectionSegment if IsDone returns True. else NotDone is raised.

instanceMethods.name: Segment
instanceMethods.comment: returns the IntersectionSegment of range <Index> raises NotDone if the computation has failed or if the computation has not been done raises OutOfRange if Index is not in the range <1..NbSegment>

instanceMethods.name: IsParallel
instanceMethods.comment: Returns true if curve is parallel or belongs surface This case is recognized only for some pairs of analytical curves and surfaces (plane - line, ...).

instanceMethods.name: Dump
instanceMethods.comment: Dump all the fields.

classes.name: IntCurveSurface_IntersectionSegment
classes.summary: A IntersectionSegment describes a segment of curve (w1,w2) where distance(C(w),Surface) is less than a given tolerances.

instanceMethods.name: NbVariables
instanceMethods.comment: Returns the number of variables of the function.

instanceMethods.name: NbEquations
instanceMethods.comment: Returns the number of equations of the function.

instanceMethods.name: Value
instanceMethods.comment: Computes the values <F> of the Functions for the variable <X>. Returns True if the computation was done successfully, False otherwise.

instanceMethods.name: Derivatives
instanceMethods.comment: Returns the values <D> of the derivatives for the variable <X>. Returns True if the computation was done successfully, False otherwise.

instanceMethods.name: Values
instanceMethods.signature: (X: math_Vector, F: math_Vector, D: math_Matrix): boolean
instanceMethods.comment: returns the values <F> of the functions and the derivatives <D> for the variable <X>. Returns True if the computation was done successfully, False otherwise.

constructors.comment: compute the solution point with the close point MarginCoef is the coefficient for extension of UV bounds. Ex., UFirst -= MarginCoef*(ULast-UFirst)

instanceMethods.name: Perform
instanceMethods.signature: (U: number, V: number, W: number, Rsnld: math_FunctionSetRoot, u0: number, v0: number, u1: number, v1: number, w0: number, w1: number): void
instanceMethods.comment: compute the solution it's possible to write to optimize: IntImp_IntCS inter(S1,C1,Toltangency) {@link math_FunctionSetRoot | `math_FunctionSetRoot`} rsnld(Inter.function()) while ...{ u=... v=... w=... inter.Perform(u,v,w,rsnld) } or IntImp_IntCS inter(Toltangency) inter.SetSurface(S); {@link math_FunctionSetRoot | `math_FunctionSetRoot`} rsnld(Inter.function()) while ...{ C=... inter.SetCurve(C); u=... v=... w=... inter.Perform(u,v,w,rsnld) }
